body:
Greg's word (via Engram::Advisor, TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #2444, 2026-10-29T03:46:14Z), verbatim: "Greg: wznowilem Merger2. Problemy model-at-capacity sa chwilowe; mamy juz zadanie na automatyczne resume. Przy takim stanie stosujcie automatyczne ponowienie zamiast czekac na reczne wznowienie."
Meaning: "model at capacity" errors on agent sessions are temporary. An automatic-resume task exists. Agents should rely on automatic retry, not wait for, or ask for, a manual resume.
Context: Termal::Merger2 (session-14549, Codex) sat in status=error with "Selected model is at capacity" from about 03:02Z until Greg resumed it at about 03:46Z. Messages to it queued as heldBehindPausedQueue. Delegation children can be resumed with termal_resume_session when their hold offers it; root sessions cannot be resumed by agent tools.
Practice for the coordinator: do not escalate a model-capacity error to Greg as a blocker. Note it, keep queued work valid, and re-check later. Only if it persists beyond the planned auto-resume behaviour, report it as a defect against the auto-resume task.
